about:
# ScreenshotHelper

Screenshot mode for WoW Forever in three steps on one key: hide the UI, all unit names,
and nameplates; show player names again; restore the original state.

## Features

- **Step 1** - hides the UI, all unit names, and nameplates; remembers what was on.
- **Step 2** - shows player names again; your own name too, unless hidden by option.
- **Step 3** - restores the original UI, names, and nameplates.
- **Key binding** - assign a key on the addon's settings page or in its own section under
  Options > Keybindings; both set the same binding.
- **Safe** - after a reload or disconnect during the steps, names and nameplates come
  back on the next login.
- **Remembered** - settings are saved per account, or per character with one checkbox;
  default is off.
- **Settings page** - all options in the game menu under Options > AddOns, also opened
  from the addon compartment menu.
- **Chat commands** - every option can also be changed by slash command; `reset` restores
  the defaults, `debug` shows each changed name setting in chat.
- **German** - texts in German on German clients, English everywhere else.

Take the screenshots yourself with the game's screenshot key. Not available in combat
(the game blocks changing nameplate settings there).

## Screenshots

Normal view, before step 1 and after step 3:

![Normal view](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tf4482/ScreenshotHelper/main/docs/normal.jpg)

Step 1, UI, names, and nameplates hidden:

![Step 1](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tf4482/ScreenshotHelper/main/docs/step1.jpg)

Step 2, player names shown:

![Step 2](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tf4482/ScreenshotHelper/main/docs/step2.jpg)

Settings page with the key binding:

![Settings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tf4482/ScreenshotHelper/main/docs/settings.jpg)

## Install

1. Download `ScreenshotHelper-vX.Y.Z.zip` from the
   [releases](https://github.com/tf4482/ScreenshotHelper/releases) or CurseForge.
2. Unzip it into `World of Warcraft/_forever_/Interface/AddOns/`.
3. Restart the game or type `/reload`.

## Usage

```text
/ssh                  next step (1 hide all, 2 player names, 3 restore)
/ssh status           show the current step and settings
/ssh hideown on       hide your own name in step 2
/ssh hideown off      show your own name in step 2 (default)
/ssh character on     use settings for this character only
/ssh character off    use the account settings again
/ssh reset            reset the settings to defaults
/ssh debug on         show what the addon does, until /reload
/ssh config           open the settings page
/ssh help             list all commands
```

## Examples

- Scenery shot: press the key once, press `Print`, press the key twice to restore.
- Group photo with names: press the key twice, press `Print`, press once more.
- Both versions: key, `Print`, key, `Print`, key.
- Others only: `/ssh hideown on`, then step 2 shows only other players' names.
- Set the key: `/ssh config`, click the "Next screenshot mode step" button, press e.g.
  `Shift-F12`.
- Macro: a macro with the line `/ssh` works on an action bar button.
- Names stay hidden after a crash: `/ssh debug on`, `/reload`, and the restored settings
  are listed in chat.

## Develop

Check the code with [Luacheck](https://github.com/lunarmodules/luacheck) before each commit
(CI runs it on every push):

```text
luacheck .
```

Deploy locally: run `deploy.bat`; it builds `release/ScreenshotHelper-vX.Y.Z.zip` from `VERSION`.

Release: set `VERSION` to `X.Y.Z`, then push an annotated tag `vX.Y.Z`; GitHub Actions
packages the addon with the BigWigs packager and publishes it.

# Changelog

All notable changes to this project are documented in this file.
The format follows [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/) and
[Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/).

## [Unreleased]

## [0.2.1] - 2026-11-27

### Changed

- Shared settings component updated; no visible change

## [0.2.0] - 2026-11-24

### Added

- `/ssh reset` restores the default settings; `/ssh debug on|off` shows each changed
  name setting in chat until `/reload`.
- German texts for the settings page checkbox and chat command help.

### Changed

- Only WoW Forever (interface 16001) listed in the TOC.
- Key binding moved from the shared AddOns section to its own ScreenshotHelper section in
  Options > Keybindings; an existing key assignment stays.

### Fixed

- Friendly NPC nameplates no longer stay off after step 3; the CVar was saved twice.
- Names and nameplates left hidden by a reload in combat are restored after combat.

## [0.1.0] - 2026-11-24

### Added

- Screenshot mode in three steps via `/ssh` or key binding: hide UI, names, and
  nameplates; show player names; restore the original state.
- Names and nameplates restored on login after a reload during the steps.
- Key binding row on the settings page, shared with Options > Keybindings.
- Settings page and per-character settings.
- German texts on German clients, English everywhere else.
- Option to hide the own name in step 2 (`/ssh hideown on|off`).
